body: OWNER CORRECTION — the second readers are right: my phrase DOM data-name set equals compiled MarkId set was too broad across the hybrid page. GraphicsNames has two identity domains that must not be unioned. The Atlas SVG equality is unique Atlas data-name values == lowered scene MarkIds. The paginated Codex overlay equality is unique Codex data-name values == placed FragmentIds, with flow-level AnnotationIds checked through their fragment derivation/navigation. V-L2 is a separate address-to-SelectionPlacement assertion and must read CodexFlow.selectionPlacements directly; overlay presence/piece count is not a placement state. I also accept F3 dual source hashes, F5 project-pinned Playwright, and named OnMark/ViaAncestor/OffProjection scenarios. This corrects my review statement before implementation; no source edit from me.
